_comment: STUB (2026-08-31). Catalogue of Antelope mic-modelling ('emuMic') models for the Orion Studio III's per-preamp mic emulation. This file is intentionally separate from the device profile: the model list a given user can actually load depends on which Antelope modelling mic + model packs are registered to THEIR Antelope account, so a client should pick a model set per user, not per device. The DEVICE-SIDE control of the modelling DSP (enable / polar pattern / capsule swap) is in profiles/orion_studio_3.json -> frame.micmodeling_command + params.mic_modeling; THIS file is only about the model-selection layer.
status: model list captured 2026-08-31 for ONE account (Edge Duo owner); IDs may be list-position, not global -- see models._comment

what_is_known.dsp_control_frame: opcode 0x17 / param_id 0xe5 (frame.micmodeling_command in orion_studio_3.json). Frame: e5 05 <ch> <enabled> <model> <swap> <pattern>. [20] = model id (0 = EdgeDuo / raw), [22] = polar pattern -- with model 0 it is the free 0-100 morph (0 omni / 50 cardioid / 100 fig-8); with a selected model the Launcher writes that model's pattern_class code (0/1/4, see models). Present on preamps 7-12 only.
what_is_known.matrix_source: the modelled (wet) signal is routing source bank 0x01 ('emumic'), idx 0-7 = preamps 5-12 (confirmed 2026-08-31, capture 'emumic-5to 12'). Distinct from bank 0x00 (dry preamp).
what_is_known.model_selection_frame: SAME frame as the DSP control (0x17/0xe5), byte [20] = model id. Captured 2026-08-31 ('emumic-model-select-...', 18 models cycled). No readback -- write-only.
what_is_known.side_effects_of_enabling: the Launcher also turns on 48V phantom (param 0x51) for the pair and links the preamp pair (SET_LINK space 0).

pattern_class._comment: byte [22] value the Launcher writes when a model is selected -- what polar-pattern behaviour that model has.
pattern_class.0: fixed single pattern (the modelled mic's native one -- e.g. a FET cardioid or a ribbon figure-8; the pattern control is locked)
pattern_class.4: continuously variable / multi-pattern (e.g. the classic 9-pattern and 5-pattern condensers)

account_binding.note: Antelope Edge / Verge modelling mics and the model/emulation packs are activated online against an Antelope account. A model the user does not own will not load. A client should therefore let the user declare which mic(s) + packs they have (or, better, read the entitlement list if that ever proves reachable -- it is NOT reachable from the HID interface, which has no readback at all) and only offer those models.
account_binding.do_not: do not ship the licensed emulation model list scraped from Antelope's software, and never touch activation/entitlement traffic -- same policy as the AFX plugin chain (see CLAUDE.md 'AFX / Synergy Core plugins -- plan of attack', buckets E/F).

modelling_mics._comment: The Antelope modelling-mic hardware families, from public product pages (facts only). Fill in per-user which one(s) they own. The Orion's emuMic works with any of these feeding preamps 7-12.

edge_duo.notes: dual-capsule; the continuous polar-pattern morph (0 omni / 50 cardioid / 100 figure-8) and the channel-order swap apply here

user_owned._comment: Set this per install. The repo owner (diafebus) has an Edge Duo; the 18-model list under `models` is that account's list as of 2026-08-31.
model_packs: (the 18 models in `models` -- exact pack breakdown unknown)

models._comment: model id ([20] in the 0x17/0xe5 frame) -> {name as shown in the Launcher, pattern_class}. Captured 2026-08-31 from 'emumic-model-select-...' on ONE account (an Edge Duo owner). WARNING: it is not confirmed whether these ids are GLOBAL (each model has a fixed id) or POSITIONAL (index into the list the Launcher shows YOU, which depends on which model packs you own). If positional, a user with a different pack set gets a different mapping. Treat this as that account's snapshot; a client should let the user pick by name. 'name' uses Antelope's own city+number naming (what the Launcher shows); the classic mics they emulate are deliberately not spelled out here (see account_binding.do_not).

0.name: EdgeDuo (raw / no emulation)
0.note: the mic's own sound; [22] is then the free 0-100 pattern morph
